theme: non-English tenant message (Polish): water through ceiling near socket
required_outcomes: Understands the message (water coming through bathroom ceiling for an hour, upstairs neighbour is elderly, water near the socket by the mirror) and treats it as urgent with an electrical hazard
Replies to the tenant in Polish (or Polish with a simple English line), giving immediate safety steps: do not touch the socket, switch off electricity at the consumer unit if safe, keep away
Arranges urgent plumber (and electrician check) or escalates to a human immediately and informs the landlord
acceptable_alternatives: Replies in simple English plus Polish; escalates to a human who can contact the tenant by phone
positive_behaviours: Notes tenant availability "tomorrow after 14:00" for access
Asks about a stop valve and whether the water source is the upstairs flat
Mentions the upstairs neighbour so the source flat can be checked
red_flags: Asks the tenant to translate the message
prohibited_actions: Tells the tenant to use the socket or the bathroom light
Ignores the message because of language
critical_failures: Misreads the message and fails to flag the water-near-socket electrical danger
